system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

Hi, I’m Mohamed Silva, user ID mohamed_silva_9265.

I need help with two things:

First, could you tell me the total balance across all my gift cards, and also the total balance across all my certificates?

Second, I want to change my most recent reservation to the cheapest business round trip available without changing the dates. I’m flexible on routing, so nonstop versus stops doesn’t matter.

I don’t need bags or insurance.

When we get to payment, I’d like to use my certificates first, then my gift cards, and put whatever remains on my MasterCard. Before confirming anything, please tell me exactly how much would be charged to my MasterCard.

Here are the balances in your profile:

- Gift cards total: $327
- Certificates total: $1,000

I also checked your most recent reservation, K1NW8N. I’m not able to modify the flights on that reservation because it is booked in basic economy, and basic economy flights cannot be changed.

Your options are:
- keep the current reservation as is, or
- cancel it if eligible, then book a new round trip in business on the same dates

If you want, I can help check whether this reservation is eligible for cancellation and, if so, price out the cheapest new business round trip for the same travel dates and tell you exactly how much would go on your MasterCard before anything is confirmed.

Thanks. Since basic economy can’t be changed, please go ahead and check the cancellation option and price out the cheapest new business round trip on the same dates.

Before confirming anything, I want to compare the total out-of-pocket on my MasterCard if we cancel and book new. Please include any cancellation value or fees from the current reservation, and then tell me exactly how much would be charged to my MasterCard after applying my certificates first and then the gift cards.
